purpose: Define remote DWH authorization so identity originates at the caller/origin while rights are evaluated by the remote target's AccessCore policy.

topics.name: DWH Remote AccessCore Enforcement
topics.purpose: Define remote DWH authorization so identity originates at the caller/origin while rights are evaluated by the remote target's AccessCore policy.

semantics.identity_rule: Caller identity/assurance context is propagated from origin according to IAM semantics.
semantics.rights_rule: Remote target evaluates rights using its own AccessCore policy.
semantics.nonexpansion_rule: Delegated remote path cannot expand rights beyond what the remote policy grants.
semantics.local_rule: Local owner authority and delegated remote authority remain distinct.
semantics.transport_rule: Authenticated/encrypted transport does not itself grant DWH rights.
semantics.failure_rule: Denied remote operation returns explicit authorization failure without fallback to direct EXT access.

invariants.rule: DWH scope, release, remote access and policy decisions remain explicit, provenance-preserving and separate from transport reachability.

hard_gates.condition: remote rights copied blindly from origin
delegated remote path expands remote rights
denial falls back to direct EXT dereference
caller identity lost at remote policy boundary
